statement: Push lab to Killer Bright Side and No Bubble Left Behind as early as possible for progression
Lab needs characters uploaded to the main frame in a daisy chain; you keep a node's bonus while it stays connected
Once per day it randomly upgrades a few of your lowest-level bubbles within the first 15 bubbles of each cauldron
Killer Bright Side grants double kills which makes world progression smoother
Buy souped-up lab tubes from the gem shop to speed up getting connected in the lab
Phase one cooking powerhouses are egg and corn dog and cabbage with cabbage the best
Phase two needs the Diamond Chef bubble in the yellow cauldron which boosts cooking speed per diamond plate (meal level 11)
Stockpile the bleach dock salts spice and only spend it with bargain tag; one upgrade gets up to 90% cost reduction
Phase three revolves around Vman's blood marrow which multiplies cooking speed per level in each meal for several trillion percent quickly
Eclipse gives Blood Berserker Super Chow: 1.1x cooking speed per mob with 100M+ kills for a 2480x multiplier
Hole (world 5) and atom collider fluoride also give huge cooking speed bonuses
Later boron lets you upgrade Diamond Chef without using spices
At Demon Gits (4th map of world 4) you unlock the next class upgrade; first priority is Divine Knight from Squire
Divine Knight is among the best to push in w4-5 thanks to Imbued Shockwave (free shockwave chance) and Divine Intervention (respawns all monsters when cleared)
Bubo is faster at clearing portals but needs lots of investment to be potent
Divine Knight needs only one talent point for 100% Divine Intervention effectiveness so more points go to attack talents
Divine Knight uses the least mana in the game which helps keep active kills per hour up
Divine Knight is not strong AFK with poor AFK kills per hour so it is mostly used actively
After Divine Knight prioritize Blood Berserker and Beastmaster and Bubonic Conjuror to get the most out of the world 4 skills
Unlock Voidwalker as soon as possible for some of the best account-wide bonuses in the game
Voidwalker gives trapping and worship soul multiplier from species epoch and cooking speed from blood marrow and statue multiplier from voodoo statification and eternal stat talents
Eclipse upgrades at least one talent from each of the other classes
Eclipse'd whale wallop gives +25 max whale summons and range and 50% per kill to cut egg incubator time by 3 seconds including all kills
Voidwalker needs a maestro from the secret world 1 quest line at level 50 and completing three Nebulite quests
Nebulite sits under the world 5 portal and you must be on your maestro at level 150 to start the quests
Quests: 1M death note kills on all world 1-3 monsters and defeat cheese on chaotic and 12M green mushroom kills on maestro
You can use time candies to speed up the Nebulite quest kill requirements
Line width is the connection between players and increases when you level a character's lab skill
Connection range between player and node does not increase with lab level; it comes from other sources so you must be close to the node
Once farming in world 4 with enough coins hitting the world 4 shop should be a top priority
Buy multiple processor chips and strong jewels to unlock the new shop by the lab selling lab jewels and chips on weekly rotation
Buy blue tome pages from the world 4 shop to unlock a new percent skill efficiency bonus in the tome
Pick up sappy DNA splicers from the shop as extra stat sticks for characters
At this point you can probably afford all storage chest bags and stamps from every shop up to world 4 so grab them
There are currently 67 meals and each gives a specific stat bonus across the game
Ribbons multiply meal bonuses massively like 1800% all golden food from Yumi Peach Ring or 800 basic attack speed from Cauliflower
Blood marrow gives cooking speed based on total meal levels so level up even meals that seem poor
Orb of Remembrance on Divine Knight in the coliseum or purple mushroom map's mutated mush miniboss gives more loot with a bigger orb
Farm mutated mush with a high orb count to get pet eggs and ladles; you can net around 100 eggs in the late game
Gray DNA is very hard to get and the only way is by treasuring pets
Prioritize breedability pulse and rarity of eggs and past present brood first when upgrading breeding
One level of breedability pulse unlocks breeding breedable pets; pets in the fence yard raise the breedability meter and you can stack several
Rarity of eggs upgrades eggs from base to bronze to silver and so on raising new pet chance
Past present brood boosts new pet chance based on pets unlocked in the previous world
Blooming axe is a nice upgrade for foraging spices and the other breeding upgrades are pretty solid
Choco chip comes from the chip repository shop and is a god-tier chip with a terrible rotation
The choco chip rotation can mean waiting up to 6 months before it shows up again
To unlock choco chip you need cheese and the beach spice from cooking and pinion spurs from the anvil
Choco chip gives a 75% chance to respawn another crystal mob when one dies for crystal farming
Gambling for choco chip in the gem shop is not suggested
Complete Rift Ripper's quest line in the Octodar map to access the rift
Every five rift challenges unlock a bonus; push through the first 10 as soon as you can
Rift 10 unlocks infinite star signs making all star signs active at all times with no penalty
Infinite star sign requires leveling some shiny pets first
Later rift unlocks include auto-collect pets and a new card tier and big damage multipliers
Start saving resources for troll armor by the end of world 4 since it is the turning point in gear progression
Troll armor requires 10000 nolos which is a hard hurdle
Being salt locked hampers early mid and late game; stockpile now though it is more of a world 6 thing
